entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah... I hope you can help. I need to return an item, but I've had it for a little while and I'm just so worried. I've been a loyal customer for years.
Of course, I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I have your order number?
Yes, it's VF88602. It's for the Aero Race Jersey. I just feel awful about this.
Okay, I have your order pulled up. I see the Aero Race Jersey, purchased 83 days ago. Can you tell me what specifically is the issue with it? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, it's just... it's the wrong size. I thought I could make it work, but it's just way too tight. I wanted to do an exchange, but things are a bit tough right now and I really could use the money back. I feel so guilty for waiting this long.
I completely understand, and please don't feel guilty at all. Let me check the return eligibility for you right now. One moment.
Alright, I have good news. That jersey falls under our standard 90-day return policy. Since you received it 83 days ago, you are still well within the window to return it for a full refund.
Oh, really? Are you sure? That is... that's such a relief. Thank you so much. I was so stressed about this.

It's absolutely my pleasure to help. And because I see you're one of our VIP customers, I'm going to go ahead and email you a pre-paid return label, so you don't have to worry about the shipping cost. Is the email on file still correct?
Yes, it is! You have no idea what a help that is. You've made my day, Sarah. I was dreading making this call.

I'm so glad I could resolve this for you. I've just sent that label over. Once we receive the jersey, you can expect the refund to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist with?
No, that's everything. Thank you again. You've been wonderful.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
